headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth, led by AI‑driven firms, but profit momentum varied.
summary: Revenue grew across the board, with Coforge posting a 53.6% YoY jump and HCLTech and TCS delivering double‑digit growth. AI contributed noticeably, especially at Infosys (+29% AI revenue) and Mphasis (AI deals two‑thirds of contract value). Profit growth was uneven; Infosys and HCLTech saw modest gains, while Wipro's profit fell and several firms trimmed guidance. Margin expansion was mixed, with OFSS reporting a 47.8% EBIT margin but most peers staying in the mid‑teens.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue and deals drove double‑digit top‑line growth at several firms, notably Infosys, Mphasis and LTM.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% outlook, reflecting cautious expectations.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins ranged from 10% at Persistent to 47.8% at OFSS, highlighting varied cost structures and pricing power.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
11.5% YoY revenue growth, 21% profit jump and strong AI revenue of $219 m.
